description: Netty Transport Native Epoll provides Linux epoll-based native transport support for Netty. It gives Netty applications high-performance event loops, channels, and JNI-backed native socket features on Linux.

skipped-versions.reason: io.netty:netty-transport-native-epoll:4.1.54.Final depends on io.netty:netty-common:4.1.54.Final, whose published jar ships the Native Image substitution io.netty.util.NetUtilSubstitutions with @InjectAccessors accessor classes for NetUtil.LOCALHOST, LOCALHOST4 and LOCALHOST6 that define get() but no set(), so native-image aborts with a HostedError ('found no method named set or setLOCALHOST4') when it parses NetUtil's static initializer; fixed upstream in 4.1.55.Final (netty/netty#10799), which adds the setters.
